title: Active military personnel bring UAP videos to the congressman
summary: Eric Burlison tells of Active military personnel bring UAP videos to the congressman, about c. 2023-2026 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I get people from that are active military personnel that come to me as a member of Congress and and have videos that they they'll show me

plain: Eric Burlison, a member of the US Congress, says that sometime between 2023 and 2026, people on active military duty came to him in his Washington office and showed him videos of UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. If true, it would mean serving troops are going around their chain of command to get such footage in front of lawmakers.
